answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the falcon of the next round. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, slashed on a failed audit, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the fable of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
